title: useful every day
text: useful every day. These are truly the cat's meow.  If you've never used them, I recommend you try them.  I purchased one a few years ago and have been struggling to find more since.  Because they are silicone you can heat them.. obviously you can pinch them slightly and easily pour from them... I reach for these over and over.  They really are  worth it.  I will of course update if there is anything useful to report.
